name: ouroboros
description: Self-learning for Claude Code: reviews your sessions, turns what is worth keeping into memories and skills, and shows usage, value and cost on a local dashboard.

measure_review.title: End-of-session measurement
measure_review.description: After each session, a small isolated model call counts corrections and lists what could have been learned (nothing is written). Builds the baseline.

reviewer_model.title: Reviewer model
reviewer_model.description: Model used by the background reviewer.

monthly_budget_usd.title: Monthly reviewer budget (USD)
monthly_budget_usd.description: Background reviews stop for the rest of the month once this is spent.

long_turn_tool_calls.title: Long turn threshold
long_turn_tool_calls.description: Tool calls in a single turn that mark it as a long autonomous turn.
